Optical Circuit Switching (OCS)
What is an OCS?
Optical switch that provides configurable pure optical paths between optical input and output ports.
Multiple technologies available: Robotic, Beam Steering, Silicon Photonic
Why use OCS?
Traffic-agnostic
● Compatible with current and future link speeds
● Compatible with any current and future protocols
● No Optical-Electrical-Optical Conversions
○ No choke points, queues, or buffers to overflow 
○ Security: No traffic snooping
Low latency
● Speed of light vs. ASIC switching latency
Cost-effective
● No transceivers
● Lower power consumption (less than 5% compared to traditional electric packet switches)

• Connection Management
Module: oc-optical-switch-connections
+--rw connections
+--ro last-change-time           yang:date -and-time
+--rw port-connection* [name]
+--ro name leafref -> ../config/name
+--rw config
|  +--rw name     string // arbitrary name selected by controller
|  +--rw input-port-name leafref -> /oc-platform:components/component/name
|  +--rw output-port-name     leafref -> /oc-platform:components/component/name
+--ro state
+--ro name                 string
+--ro input-port-name leafref -> /oc-platform:components/component/name
+--ro output-port-name leafref -> /oc-platform:components/component/name
+--ro status               {CONNECTED, CONNECTING, DELETING, FAILED, INVALID}
+--ro status-reason        string
+--ro last-updated         yang:date -and-time
What’s New

• Free integration with extendable component hierarchies
• Simultaneous visibility to:
• Current active status [ocp-ocs-port] and
• Intent [optical-switch-connections]

from gNMI front-end
